newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PARIS ST GERMAIN WANT NIGERIA'S WEST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PARIS ST GERMAIN WANT NIGERIA'S WEST.

text.p: Paris St Germain are attempting to sign Auxerre's Nigerian international Taribo West, sources close to the Paris club said on Wednesday.
PSG, who have a budget of 120 million francs ($20.6 million) to spend on players, plan to pair the 23-year-old West with French international Bruno Ngotty in central defence.
Auxerre trainer Guy Roux said West's contract did not end until next year but added he was ready to let him go.

Paris St Germain, second in the French fist division 12 points behind Monaco with four matches remaining, will have a much-changed team next season as several of their current players plan to move to new clubs.
Goalkeeper Bernard Lama, Portuguese defender Daniel Kenedy and Panamanian striker Julio Cesar Dely Valdes are among those planning to move after the season ends.

But Brazilians Leonardo and Rai have said they want to stay and so has striker Patrice Loko, who proved he was back at his brilliant best by scoring four goals to help PSG crush Nice 5-0 at Parc des Princes on Sunday.
